answer: Trace where each identity's first tokens came from. At dawn each epoch, the economy groups keys by funding ancestry: wallets seeded from one source stand on the same mesa, and that whole plateau shares a single reward cap however many keys crowd onto it. A farm can split its capital a thousand ways, but every branch still hangs from one trunk, like willow shoots from a single root, so extra keys add no payout. Independently funded agents each keep a full cap, and laundering through fresh intermediaries costs fees and delay at every hop.
